The '''1981–82 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], two points ahead of [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]]. The league was won on the final day of the season 
when Celtic defeated [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]] 3–0 at [[Celtic Park]] on 15 May 1982. [[Partick Thistle F.C.|Partick Thistle]] and [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] were relegated.
